Reference: files

The files qargi reads and writes in its configuration and state directories: the answers, registry, profiles, packs, audit log and collected runs.

Updated 2026-11-05

PathWhat it holds
~/.qargi/config/projects/NAME.jsonthe answers about a project
~/.qargi/config/instances.jsonthe registry of instances
~/.qargi/config/profiles/NAME.mda repository's gates and review rules, given to agents with a task
~/.qargi/config/packs/the library of skills and tools, and their links
~/.qargi/config/credentials/token files, mode 600
~/.qargi/config/install.jsonthe tool root install.sh recorded; a checkout run from elsewhere is a dev run
~/.qargi/state/sessions.jsonthe tracker of cloud sessions
~/.qargi/state/audit.logappend-only record of every approved or cloud verb, with your words
~/.qargi/state/runs/collected outputs of runs

Nothing is stored in a repository. See also Where things are.

Checked against qargi 0.2.1.
